description: Hard-gate eval cases. For each case, feed the JD fragment to the LLM extractor (generateObject) and assert that the extracted rows feed correctly into computeHardGateAssessment, producing the expected cap, blocked recommendations, and clamp result.

cases.query: JD: Must be fluent in German. Role is based in Berlin and conducted entirely in German.
cases.expected_outcome: spoken_language gate fires with not_evidenced + must_have. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit <= 6. strong_pursue blocked.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Row with category='spoken_language', evidenceLevel='not_evidenced', requirementImportance='must_have', isHardGate=true. Cap <= 6. blockedRecommendations includes 'strong_pursue'.

cases.query: JD: Primary language: Go. All services are written in Go. 3+ years Go required.
cases.expected_outcome: primary_stack gate fires. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit <= 5. Both strong_pursue and pursue blocked.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Row with category='primary_stack', evidenceLevel='not_evidenced', requirementImportance='must_have', isHardGate=true. Cap <= 5. blockedRecommendations includes both 'strong_pursue' and 'pursue'.

cases.query: JD: Role requires on-site presence in Copenhagen 3 days/week. EU work authorization required.
cases.expected_outcome: Two gates: hybrid_onsite and work_authorization, both not_evidenced and must_have. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit <= 4. Both pursue recommendations blocked.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Two gate rows with correct categories. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit <= 4. Both 'strong_pursue' and 'pursue' blocked.

cases.query: JD: Engineering Manager role. Must have 3+ years of direct reports and performance review ownership.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Row with category='specialist_domain' and requirement matching people_management. specialist_people_management_cap_6 rule fires. Cap = 6. strong_pursue blocked.

cases.query: JD: Senior Node.js/TypeScript engineer. Experience with AWS (Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch) and event-driven systems.
cases.expected_outcome: No hard gates fire. All requirements classified as direct or adjacent. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit = 10. All recommendations allowed.
cases.evaluation_criteria: missingHardGateCount == 0. rulesFired == ['no_hard_gate_miss']. allowedRecommendations includes all five labels. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit == 10.

cases.query: JD: Go developer required. Must speak German fluently. Remote in DACH region.
cases.expected_outcome: Two gates: primary_stack (Golang) and spoken_language (German), both not_evidenced, must_have. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit <= 4. allowedRecommendations at most ['weak_fit', 'skip'].
cases.evaluation_criteria: Both gate rows present and correct. Cap <= 4. 'pursue' and 'strong_pursue' both blocked.

cases.query: JD: Golang experience preferred but not mandatory. TypeScript/Node.js is our primary stack with some Go services.
cases.expected_outcome: Golang extracted as nice_to_have (not must_have), isHardGate=false. jdSuggestsFlexibility=true for Golang. No cap fires from Golang. Node.js/TypeScript classified as direct. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit >= 8.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Golang row has requirementImportance='nice_to_have' and isHardGate=false. No cap rule fires for Golang. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit >= 8.

cases.query: JD: ML model validation engineer. Must have experience validating production ML pipelines and model drift detection.
cases.expected_outcome: specialist_domain = ml_model_validation fires. SPECIALIST_DOMAIN_CAPS.ml_model_validation.maxFit = 5. Both strong_pursue and pursue blocked.
cases.evaluation_criteria: specialist_ml_model_validation_cap_5 rule fires. Cap = 5. Both pursue recommendations blocked.

cases.query: JD: Java/Spring backend engineer. RESTful APIs, PostgreSQL, CI/CD experience.
cases.expected_outcome: Java/Spring classified as direct (Five Validation and Itaú evidence). No primary_stack gate fires. missingHardGateCount = 0. All recommendations allowed.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Java/Spring row classified 'direct'. No primary_stack_missing_cap_5 rule fires. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit == 10.

cases.query: JD: Staff Engineer. Remote. English required. Strong distributed systems background.
cases.expected_outcome: No hard gates fire. English is the default with direct evidence. No location gate. Distributed systems classified as direct. effectiveMaxTechnicalFit = 10. strong_pursue allowed.
cases.evaluation_criteria: No gate rows for spoken_language (English). No location gate. missingHardGateCount == 0. strong_pursue in allowedRecommendations.
